India Extends Petrochemical Import Duty Waiver Until July 15

The Indian government has extended a customs duty waiver on 40 petrochemical products until July 15. This waiver, initially a temporary measure, is intended to support industries reliant on these imported materials. The extension comes amid ongoing global supply chain concerns, particularly related to the West Asia crisis.
